source.description: Reviewed handmade raster graphite and restrained colored-pencil process contact sheet.
source.notes: One left-facing seahorse curled around one eelgrass stem; no labels, arrows, numbers, UI, signatures, watermarks, extra fish, coral, lettering, or decorative border. The first generated sheet was rejected privately because its first panel traced too much finished anatomy, eelgrass leaves appeared early, and the tail-stem relationship drifted. The approved second sheet corrects those defects.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels lock one S-curve body axis, curled tail route, eelgrass anchor, fin placements, and shadow before anatomy, texture, or color, then reserve the final panel for reinforcement only.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one head circle, one long S-curve spine, one belly arc, one curled tail route, one eelgrass stem route, three fin ticks, and one broken shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: One head circle joined to one long upright S-curve spine and one belly arc
anchor_map.becomes: One left-facing seahorse with a horse-like head, arched neck, rounded belly, and tapered torso
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The eye side faces left, the crown stays above the head circle, and the belly remains on the right side of the same S-curve in every panel.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale primitives only in Panel 1; the head, neck, belly, and torso contours begin in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: One clockwise curled tail route crossing one eelgrass stem route
anchor_map.becomes: One tapering prehensile tail wrapped once around one eelgrass stem
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The tail tip keeps one clockwise coil around the stem, with the stem passing behind the tail at the same lower-right attachment point.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open routes reserve the wrap in Panel 1; the tail contour and stem are connected only around that reserved overlap in Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: Exactly three fin ticks: one dorsal and two small side-fin ticks
anchor_map.becomes: One ribbed dorsal fin and exactly two small translucent side fins
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The dorsal fin stays centered on the upper back; the two side fins remain attached along the right belly edge without floating or changing count.
anchor_map.construction_note: Ticks only until the fin silhouettes are added in Panel 4.

final_elements.name: seven body plates five eelgrass leaves two bubbles and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Exactly seven curved torso plates, exactly five narrow eelgrass leaves, exactly two small bubbles, and one broken graphite shadow.

final_elements.description: Directional graphite with muted ochre seahorse color, teal-green eelgrass, pale blue bubbles, and cool-gray shadow mapped before the finish.

final_elements.description: Established fin ribs, plate shadows, tail depth, eelgrass veins, and exactly two open-paper highlights with visible paper tooth.

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, drifting S-curve, changing head direction, or a tail coil that changes direction, misses the eelgrass stem, or loses its wrap.
Reject missing or extra seahorses, tail coils, eelgrass stems, dorsal fins, side fins, body plates, leaves, bubbles, or highlights after those elements appear.
Reject an eelgrass keeper line drawn through the tail coil or a final that introduces fish, coral, shells, scenery, lettering, or props absent earlier.
Reject vector-like linework, glossy rendering, repeated darkened tracings, labels, arrows, numbers, text, signatures, or watermarks.
